atoms.name: Purpose of CV
atoms.one_line: Estimate generalisation error and tune hyperparameters without touching the test set.

atoms.name: k-fold mechanics
atoms.one_line: $k$ disjoint folds; train on $k-1$, validate on one; each sample validates once.

atoms.name: Counting splits and fits
atoms.one_line: Exclude test data first; fits $=$ grid $\times k$ ($+1$ refit).

atoms.name: CV error estimate
atoms.one_line: Average (or size-weighted pooled) error over folds.

atoms.name: Bias, variance, cost of CV
atoms.one_line: LOOCV: low bias, $n$ fits; $k=5$ or $10$ is the default.

atoms.name: Stratification and leakage
atoms.one_line: Keep class ratios; fit all preprocessing inside the fold.

atoms.name: Model selection
atoms.one_line: Pick the hyperparameter with the lowest mean CV error, then refit.
